about-intro:
Hi, I'm Kim Đan! I'm a curious content marketer who loves figuring out what makes people care, then turning that into content that feels natural, not forced.
Outside of work, I'm a full-time mom to three tiny cats, so when I say I love pets, I really mean it. 🐱🐱🐱 That's why Truoo Pet Care feels exciting to me: a chance to combine what I genuinely care about with what I love doing.
